meta.title: AutoHostAI — The operational layer for your vacation rental
meta.description: AutoHostAI centralises reservations, cleaning, maintenance and incidents in one operational console for short-term rentals.

hero.title: One console for your entire short-term rental operation
hero.subtitle: AutoHostAI connects your PMS to cleaning, maintenance, incidents and reporting. Your team works from the same information — no spreadsheets falling out of date.

reservations.title: Centralised reservations
reservations.body: A single view of every stay: check-ins, check-outs, payments and last-minute changes, synced with your PMS.

cleaning.title: Cleaning and maintenance
cleaning.body: Tasks, handover photos and reminders that close the loop between your cleaning crew, technicians and guests.

incidents.title: Incident control
incidents.body: Open, assign and close with a traceable history. Every incident knows which stay and property it belongs to.

analytics.title: Operational analytics
analytics.body: Response time, effective occupancy and per-stay cost — the numbers that actually move your bottom line.

stats.line2: Built on the stack your team already trusts
